mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document_image (id, document_id, uploader_id, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes, object_key) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{image.id}), HEXTORAW(#{image.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{image.uploaderId}), #{image.fileName}, #{image.mimeType}, #{image.sizeBytes}, #{image.objectKey})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(uploader_id) AS uploaderId, file_name AS fileName, mime_type AS mimeType, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, object_key AS objectKey FROM edudoc_document_image WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex})
